title: Use `latestRoundData` instead of `latestAnswer`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  `UniV3TokenizedLp` is calling `latestAnswer()` to get the last oracle price. This method will return the last value, but you will not be able to check if the data is fresh.
